ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Double Extension Files
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects dropped files with double extensions, which is often used by malware as a method to abuse the fact that Windows hide default extensions by default.

sequences.query: (((file_path = RGX("\\\.exe$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.iso$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.rar$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.svg$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.zip$")) AND (file_path = RGX(".*\\\.doc\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.docx\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.gif\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.jpeg\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.jpg\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.mp3\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.mp4\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.pdf\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.png\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.ppt\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.pptx\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.rtf\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.svg\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.txt\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.xls\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.xlsx\\\..*"))) OR (file_path = RGX("\\\.rar\\\.exe$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.zip\\\.exe$")))
